---
title: "DEV REPORT `r params$title`"
subtitle: "`r params$subtitle`"
author: "`r params$author`"
format: 
  html:
    fig-width: 12
    fig-height: 10
    toc: true
    toc-title: 'N-term Report'
    title-block-banner: '#1b2944'
    title-block-banner-color: '#f79646'

execute: 
  echo: false
  warning: false
embed-resources: true
theme: 
 - layout/brand 
 - layout/custom.scss

params:
  description: ""
  design_file: ""
  input_file: ""
  folder_prj: ""
  title: ""
  subtitle: ""
  author: "" 
  select_group: ""
  sample_stat: ""
  grp_stat: ""
  glb_stat: ""
  pep_id: ""
  pep_id_sample: ""


---


```{css css_set_up}
/* Custom CSS for better visualization */
.card {
  border: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  border-radius: 0.25rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

.card-header {
  background-color: #f8f9fa;
  border-bottom: 1px solid #dee2e6;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
}

.card-body {
  padding: 1.25rem;
}

.badge {
  font-size: 0.9em;
  padding: 0.5em 1em;
}

.elements-table {
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.dataTables_wrapper {
  padding: 10px;
}
.card-header {
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.card-header:hover {
  background-color: #e9ecef;
}

.collapse-icon {
  transition: transform 0.3s ease;
}

.card-header[aria-expanded="true"] .collapse-icon {
  transform: rotate(180deg);
}

/* Animate collapse */
.collapse {
  transition: height 0.35s ease;
}

/* Optional: Style to show which card is active */
.card-header[aria-expanded="true"] {
  background-color: #e9ecef;
  border-bottom: none;
}

/* Add spacing between header elements */
.card-title {
  margin-bottom: 0;
}

.card-subtitle {
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}

/* Ensure the chevron icon aligns properly */
.fas {
  width: 1em;
  text-align: center;
}
```

```{js js_set_up}
// Add this JavaScript to handle the chevron rotation
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  document.querySelectorAll('.card-header').forEach(header => {
    header.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const isExpanded = this.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
      this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', !isExpanded);
    });
  });
  
  // Show first card by default (optional)
  const firstCard = document.querySelector('.collapse');
  if (firstCard) {
    new bootstrap.Collapse(firstCard, {
      toggle: false
    }).show();
  }
});
```

```{r import_data}

L <- readLines(params$design_file, n = 1)
    if (grepl(";", L)) expdesign <- read.csv2(params$design_file) else design <- read.csv(params$design_file)

glb_df  <-  readRDS(params$glb_stat )
grp_df <-  readRDS(params$grp_stat )

pepid_df  <-  readRDS(params$pep_id )
pepidsample_df <-  readRDS(params$pep_id_sample )


```

```{r load_packg_set_up}
#| output: false
 required_packages = c("ggrepel","ggplot","reactable",
                       "plotly","DT",'gridExtra','ggVennDiagram','dplyr' ,'logger','pander','yaml','upsetjs','htmltools','purrr')
 ntermreport::check_dependencies(required_packages)

 st=format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d_%H%M")
write(as.yaml(params), file =  file.path( params$folder_prj, paste0("NtermDDA_parameter_",st  , ".yaml")))

theme_custom_vis <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_bw(base_size = base_size) %+replace%
    theme(
      # leggend
      legend.title = element_text(size = rel(0.85), face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = rel(0.70), face = "bold"),
      legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "lines"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "transparent", colour = NA),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#bababa", color = "black"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = rel(0.85), face = "bold", color = "#1b2944", margin = margin(5,0,5,0))
    )
}

theme_set(theme_custom_vis(base_size = 18))
if (all(params$select_group != '')) {
  log_info(paste0('Selected groups: ',paste(params$select_group,collapse = ' '  )))
  selec_group_l <-  params$select_group

  all_group_ <- unique(expdesign$Group)
  }
```

# Experiment Description

`r params$description`

#  General PSMs Count
 
```{r general_viz}

#  reactable(glb_df,  columns = list(
#    percentage = colDef(format = colFormat(percent = FALSE, digits = 2,suffix='%'))
#    )
#  )

metric_descriptions <- c(
  "N-terminally"           = "PSMs identified with a free or modified N-terminus.",
  "Ace"                     =     "PSMs N-terminally Acetilated",    
  "C-terminal"             = "PSMs representing the protein C-terminus.",
  'Gln-NtermQ'              = "PSMs N-termilayy with  pyro-glutamate modification",
  "NH2"                    = "PSMs with C-terminal.",
  "N-terminally with H"     = 'PSMs N-terminally that contain Histidine in their sequence',
  "%.enrich.SCX.step"      = "Efficiency of the Strong Cation Exchange enrichment step.",
  "Total PSM"              = "Sum of N-terminally, C-terminal, and NH2 PSMs.",
  "Nterminally Acetylated" = "Fraction of N-terminal PSMs carrying an Acetyl group."
)
reactable(
  glb_df, 
  pagination = FALSE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  rowStyle = function(index) {
    if (glb_df$label[index] == "Total PSM") {
      list(fontWeight = "bold", background = "#f8f9fa", borderTop = "2px solid #dee2e6")
    } else if (glb_df$label[index] == "%.enrich.SCX.step") {
      list(fontStyle = "italic", color = "#2c3e50")
    }
  },
  columns = list(
    # Use 'Metric' if you renamed the column as discussed
    label = colDef(
      name = "Label",
      cell = function(value) {
        # Lookup description based on the row value
        desc <- metric_descriptions[value]

        # 2. Force it to be a simple string (remove names and handle NULLs)
        if (is.na(desc) || is.null(desc)) {
          display_text <- ""
        } else {
          display_text <- unname(desc) 
        }

        # Return an HTML span with a title attribute for the tooltip
        tags$span(style = "cursor: help; border-bottom: 1px dotted #ccc;", 
                  title = display_text, 
                  value)
      }
    ),
    count_absolute = colDef(name = "Count", format = colFormat(separators = TRUE,  locales = "fr-FR")),
    percentage = colDef(
      name = "Percentage",
      format = colFormat(digits = 2, suffix = "%")
    )
  )
)
```



## PSMs Count per Sample

```{r grp_viz}
grp_df <- grp_df %>%  arrange(sample)



 reactable(grp_df, groupBy= 'sample' ,  
 pagination = FALSE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  rowStyle = function(index) {
    row_label <- grp_df$label[index]
    if (is.na(row_label)) return(NULL) # Skip styling for the group header rows
    if (row_label == "Total PSM") {
      list(fontWeight = "bold", background = "#f8f9fa", borderTop = "2px solid #dee2e6")
    } else if (row_label == "%.enrich.SCX.step") {
      list(fontStyle = "italic", color = "#2c3e50")
    }
    },
  columns = list(
    # Use 'Metric' if you renamed the column as discussed
    label = colDef(
      name = "Label",
      cell = function(value) {
        # Lookup description based on the row value
        desc <- metric_descriptions[value]

        # 2. Force it to be a simple string (remove names and handle NULLs)
        if (is.na(desc) || is.null(desc)) {
          display_text <- ""
        } else {
          display_text <- unname(desc) 
        }

        # Return an HTML span with a title attribute for the tooltip
        tags$span(style = "cursor: help; border-bottom: 1px dotted #ccc;", 
                  title = display_text, 
                  value)
      }
    ),
    count_absolute = colDef(name = "Count", format = colFormat(separators = TRUE, locales = "fr-FR")),
    percentage = colDef(
      name = "Percentage",
      format = colFormat(digits = 2, suffix = "%")
    )
  )
)
 
```
